text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring) is here. Gold City's manager rushes to the waiting room to check on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her manager reminds us of Gold City's promise to quit racing if she fails to deliver a truly eye-catching performance today, but this warning only boosts Gold City's motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race, Tamamo Cross pays Gold City not even a glance. This further fills Gold City with the determination to not be outdone.
